text:
maria: heads up 1: clicking the onboarding CLI -> emoji anchor ends up 404: https://docs.redwood.inference/guides/cli#emoji. looks like the heading is 'Emoji guide' so fragment should be `#emoji-guide`. planning a tiny PR to fix and add a 1-line note about when to use emoji in examples. who owns this page? :wave:
jon: not the owner but can run a repo-wide grep for other bad `#emoji` fragments (including i18n folders) if that helps.
maria: thanks, please grep i18n too. my patch will: (1) update the fragment, (2) add a one-sentence guideline (e.g. :sparkles: for highlights, :warning: for cautions), (3) add a small linkcheck unit test under docs/tests/linkcheck. trivial change.
tara: I own the onboarding CLI guide. small PRs OK 1: open the PR and tag me, I'll review and merge if CI is green.
linkbot: task created docs:linkfix-732 "onboard-cli emoji anchor + usage note" assigned to @tara, reported by @maria
maria: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/912 - includes the fragment fix, one-liner, and a linkcheck test. ping for reviews.
jon: quick look 1: anchor change LGTM; one tiny nit about Oxford comma in the new sentence.
tara: will take the comma nit and merge once CI passes. also request that we run the grep results before merging to avoid repeat fixes across locales.
maria: will post grep results here in a follow-up message when done. thanks all!
jon: done grep: found two translations using `#emoji` in `i18n/ja/guides/cli.md` and `i18n/es/guides/cli.md`. will open a tiny follow-up PR to adjust fragments in those files and add a translated one-line note.
maria: perfect, appreciate the follow-up. I'll leave the main PR to @tara to merge when green. :rocket:
